tasks.description: Detect qualifying new ignitions and spot fires within the search scope and event-entry window.
Observe the evolving known main fire and support operational decisions using fire-state information.
Deliver the required suppression effect on the designated segment Y.
Confinement is outside this bounded demonstration.
Provide effective point protection at the Doublewide and Octagon House.

notes: Bounded analytical demonstration near Cabazon and Twin Pines, California. The incident was reported at 01:11 PDT. The mission does not restart the known main fire’s detection clock.

case_obligations.name: Shared timely observation opportunity
case_obligations.definition: Fraction/probability of qualifying events receiving a detection-capable observation in time to allow correct declaration by the event deadline

specification.reference_conditions: ≥0.98 for the same qualifying-event population as CB1. Record once and link to CB2 and CB4. Sensitivity: 0.95 / 0.98 / 0.99.
specification.description: Probability that a qualifying event receives a detection-capable observation at its location with enough time left for recognition and declaration by its own deadline.
specification.substantiation: EF-defined event-based threshold. A timely opportunity can exist even if recognition or declaration fails. Probability assessment requires a justified event population and sampling or weighting basis.
specification.population: The same qualifying-event population as CB1, including events with missed opportunities.
specification.pending: The event-population sampling or weighting basis and detectability standard remain open.

case_obligations.name: Detection-service persistence
case_obligations.definition: Maintain service for event entry 06:00–12:00 PDT; each in-scope event retains the full 25 min clock, through 12:25 for the latest entry

specification.reference_conditions: Event entry 06:00–12:00 PDT, with the full 25 min clock for each event. The latest reference deadline is 12:25 PDT for a noon ignition. A post-noon observation qualifies if it leaves enough time for declaration. Assess interruptions through EF-OBL-001 ≥0.98.
specification.description: Continuity of detection service sufficient to preserve timely observation opportunities for events entering scope.
specification.source_display:
Reference · 06:00–12:00 PDT event entry, 25 min per event. Latest reference deadline 12:25 PDT.
Sensitivity · Follows CB1 deadline settings
Units · PDT clock time, min
specification.substantiation: EF-defined service window. The extension follows from the event clock. The shared observation-opportunity obligation supplies the criterion for assessing interruptions.
specification.pending: Evaluate service interruptions using the event-based EF-OBL-001 assessment.

detection_test_design.population: Qualifying mission-relevant new ignitions or spot fires entering the analysis window and study area.
detection_test_design.eligibility: Use a common fixed set, with declared locations, ignition times, detectability and placement conditions. If cases represent spot fires, place in eligible unburned fuel and exclude advance disclosure to alternatives.
detection_test_design.sampling: Any randomized extension needs a recorded seed and common event scenarios. Fixed test attainment alone does not estimate event-population probabilities.
